# Evidence pack: Salvador Osum ("Von") dela Fuente

Defense witness, sponsor of Def. Exh. 5 (the receipts) and the only witness to the "class" · defense stage, 13 Jan to 10 Mar 2027, his date per the Pre-Trial Order [VERIFY] · Civil Case No. 26-360, MTC Mercedes · prepared for Atty. Barandon · internal; nothing here is filed or sent · supplements the 13 Oct cross binder (10 tabs), which stays as is.

> 

**His impact, in one paragraph.** Salvador is the defense's only bridge between the 1992 SPA and the Balanes. He says the SPA was shown to Gloria (S11, S13), that around 1992 they learned at Ben Llamanzares's house that the Balanes had a deal to buy the land they were renting and had paid a down payment (S14 to S15), and that he issued the receipts in Def. Exh. 5 (S19 to S22). If the court believes S14 to S15, the defense has a class member. If S14 to S15 stays hearsay with no Llamanzares paper, the defense has receipts from 2003 onward, all written by his side, and a 2016 deed. **Everything below is aimed at keeping S14 to S15 without a document, and at using his own papers against S24 to S25.**

**Three new points from his own papers** (details in Part 2):

1. His letter of 25 Nov 2025 defines the class himself: buyers holding a "CONTRACT OF SALE issued by Benjamin Llamanzares" or "RECEIPTS OF SALES signed by Benjamin Llamanzares." Def. Exh. 5 contains neither.

2. On 28 April 2016, five months before the deed, the Assessor split off exactly 2,587 sq m "PER LETTER REQUEST, SKETCH PLAN, COPY OF DEMAND LETTER AND SPA ALL SUBMITTED," with back taxes paid under ORs 0033799 to 0033800. The lot remained declared in the heirs' name. (ARP GR-2014-HH-07-001-00246.)

3. The Treasurer's statement of 31 July 2019 for the heirs' remaining land on the same mother lot (PIN 025-07-001-01-004) shows every year from 1994 to 2019 unpaid: ₱794,154.73. S24 to S25 say the collections went to pay the amilyar.

**One warning.** His letter says, "Jonathan you branded me as a BAD GUY you know I never admit it." He has already denied in writing the admission described in the 14 July 2025 email to counsel. Do not build on any oral statement from the Bacolor-office meeting (Part 4).
